description:
We’re back! Along with our partners at HHMI’s Tangled Bank Studios to produce another quest for cutting-edge science brought to you from the lab, this time in NC! 

We can’t wait to show you around the labs and introduce you to these amazing scientists all week. The first episode comes out tomorrow. Stay tuned!

Hosted by: Madelyn Leembruggen (She/Her)
